title: Rogue Protocol
author: Martha Wells
summary: The third Murderbot novella. A self-aware security android, still hiding that it has freed itself, heads to an abandoned terraforming facility to dig into a shady corporation. There it meets a researcher team and a friendly, trusting bot.
readIf: you want a short, sardonic sci-fi with plenty of action and an emotionally guarded hero.
skipIf: you haven't read the first two novellas, because this one builds directly on them.

pairings.reason: The series' first novella, if you want to start from the beginning of this character's story.
Another dry, problem-solving narrator with sarcastic commentary, working through a hostile setting.
If the AI's point of view is what appeals, this is a more serious and political take on a machine mind.
